triboar_trail_ambush.name: Triboar Trail (Goblin Ambush)
triboar_trail_ambush.description: Two dead draft horses lie sprawled in the road with black-feathered arrows protruding from their flanks. Dense briars flank both sides of the narrow trail.

exits.condition: Follow goblin trail (DC 10 Survival or track)

secrets.text: Saddlebags were raided; leather map case left behind, cut open and empty. The horses belonged to Gundren Rockseeker and Sildar Hallwinter.

cragmaw_hideout_cave_mouth.name: Cragmaw Hideout: Cave Mouth
cragmaw_hideout_cave_mouth.description: A shallow stream flows out of the hillside cave. A thick briar patch conceals a goblin lookout post on the east bank.

cragmaw_hideout_kennel.name: Cragmaw Hideout: Kennel
cragmaw_hideout_kennel.description: A dark cave smelling of animal dung and raw meat. Three ferocious wolves are chained to an iron post in the wall.
threats: 3 Wolves (Chained, snap and howl unless calmed via DC 15 Animal Handling)

cragmaw_hideout_steep_passage.name: Cragmaw Hideout: Steep Passage & Overpass
cragmaw_hideout_steep_passage.description: A steep uphill passage where the stream cascades over rocks. Above, a wooden bridge spans the passage 20 feet overhead.
hazards: Flood Trap: Goblins at Twin Pools can pull dam releases to wash creatures down the passage (DC 15 DEX save or 1d6 bludgeoning damage and knocked prone)

cragmaw_hideout_goblin_den.name: Cragmaw Hideout: Goblin Den
cragmaw_hideout_goblin_den.description: A large cavern filled with smoke from a cooking fire. Yeemik stands atop a 10-foot ledge holding a battered prisoner by the collar.

cragmaw_hideout_klargs_cave.name: Cragmaw Hideout: Klarg's Cave
cragmaw_hideout_klargs_cave.description: A large cave filled with stolen crates, barrels, and sacks. Klarg the bugbear reclines near a pile of furs with his mangy pet wolf.
treasure: Crates marked with the blue lion of Lionshield Coster
Chest with 600 cp, 110 sp, two potions of healing, and jade statuette of a frog

phandalin_town_green.name: Phandalin: Town Green
phandalin_town_green.description: A bustling frontier town with simple stone and timber cottages surrounded by the ruined stone foundations of old Phandalin. To the east, the ruined shell of Tresendar Manor looms on the hillside.

phandalin_stonehill_inn.name: Phandalin: Stonehill Inn
phandalin_stonehill_inn.description: A comfortable two-story roadhouse built of fieldstone and rough-hewn timber. The taproom is filled with local miners, prospectors, and farmers sharing rumors.

phandalin_barthens_provisions.name: Phandalin: Barthen's Provisions
phandalin_barthens_provisions.description: The largest trading post in Phandalin, stocking mining supplies, rations, tools, and dry goods.

phandalin_lionshield_coster.name: Phandalin: Lionshield Coster
phandalin_lionshield_coster.description: A fortified trading post displaying a sign painted with a blue lion on a silver shield. Armors, weapons, and adventuring gear are sold here.

phandalin_townmasters_hall.name: Phandalin: Townmaster's Hall
phandalin_townmasters_hall.description: A sturdy stone building with a small bell tower and a notice board posted outside with job bounties.

phandalin_miners_exchange.name: Phandalin: Miner's Exchange
phandalin_miners_exchange.description: A trading post where miners weigh, measure, and sell their ore. Halia Thornton operates the scale with sharp efficiency.

phandalin_shrine_of_luck.name: Phandalin: Shrine of Luck
phandalin_shrine_of_luck.description: A modest shrine constructed of timber and stone dedicated to Tymora, goddess of good fortune.

phandalin_alderleaf_farm.name: Phandalin: Alderleaf Farm
phandalin_alderleaf_farm.description: A neat, prosperous farmstead on the southern edge of town with apple orchards and fields of hay.

redbrand_hideout_crevasse.name: Redbrand Hideout: Subterranean Crevasse
redbrand_hideout_crevasse.description: A cold, damp cavern dominated by a 20-foot-deep chasm with two rickety wooden bridges spanning the divide. An unnatural chill emanates from the depths.
threats: Nothic (One-eyed aberrant horror, communicates telepathically seeking secrets, 45 HP)
treasure: Chest at bottom of crevasse with 160 sp, 120 gp, potion of healing, potion of invisibility, and +1 longsword Talon

redbrand_hideout_wizard_quarters.name: Redbrand Hideout: Glasstaff's Quarters
redbrand_hideout_wizard_quarters.description: A comfortable study with a desk, books, alchemical apparatus, and a rat scuttling on the rug.
npcs: Iarno Glasstaff Albrek (Evil Mage, 22 HP, carries Staff of Defense)
threats: Rat familiar (warns Iarno if intruders approach)
treasure: Staff of Defense (+2 AC, cast Shield/Mage Armor)
Chest under bed with scroll of charm person, scroll of fireball, and 180 gp

cragmaw_castle_throne_room.name: Cragmaw Castle: King's Quarters
cragmaw_castle_throne_room.description: A crumbling stone throne room. King Grol, a massive bugbear with thick greasy hair, interrogates a bloodied dwarf tied to a pillar.
treasure: Gundren's Map to Wave Echo Cave (under bed mattress)
Chest with 220 sp, 160 ep, three potions of healing, and spell scroll of silence

wave_echo_cave_forge_of_spells.name: Wave Echo Cave: The Forge of Spells
wave_echo_cave_forge_of_spells.description: A vast cavern housing a massive stone furnace glowing with translucent green flame. A floating spherical creature with a large central eye and four eye-stalks hovers above the brazier.
treasure: Lightbringer (+1 warhammer that glows with daylight and deals extra radiant damage to undead)
Dragonguard (+1 breastplate that grants advantage on saves vs dragon breath)

wave_echo_cave_temple_of_dumathoin.name: Wave Echo Cave: Temple of Dumathoin
wave_echo_cave_temple_of_dumathoin.description: A grand pillared hall with a towering statue of the dwarven god Dumathoin. Thick webs blanket the ceiling, where monstrous arachnids lurk in the shadows.
npcs: Nezznar the Black Spider (Drow Mage, 27 HP, carries Spider Staff)
treasure: Spider Staff (Add poison damage, cast Spider Climb and Web)
Nezznar's Journal detailing his plans to seize the Forge
Sack containing 190 ep, 130 gp, 15 sp, and a potion of flying
